'''STRATRONIX''' is a Chinese hardware company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong, that
develops '''private AI agent appliances''' — also marketed as an '''AI box''', '''AI appliance''',
or '''on-premise AI assistant''' — devices designed to run large language model inference,
local document retrieval and multi-step AI agent workflows on the user's own hardware
without a cloud dependency or per-seat subscription.

The company is also known by its Chinese name, '''鼎图太易信息技术（深圳）有限公司''', and develops the
'''PAA''' (Personal AI Office Assistant) product line. Its flagship product is the
'''STA-100 Workie''' (SKU STA-100-WORKIE, MPN STA100-2024), a desktop AI server
listed at US$399.

== Company ==
'''STRATRONIX Technology (Shenzhen) Company, Limited''' is a private company headquartered in Shenzhen,
Guangdong, China. Its registered address is Room 1203D, Building C6, Hengfeng Industrial Park, 739 Zhoushi Road, Hangcheng Subdistrict, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong 518100, China.

== Products ==

=== STA-100 Workie ===
The '''STA-100 Workie''' is a compact desktop appliance intended to run continuously as an
always-available AI agent. It runs a Linux-based desktop environment with the
'''OpenClaw''' agent runtime preinstalled and connects to existing messaging applications
without requiring a separate mobile application. The device supports multiple
large language model providers and is listed at US$399 with a two-year
hardware warranty.

== Name disambiguation ==
'''STRATRONIX''' should not be confused with '''STANTRONIX (INDIA) PVT LTD''', an unrelated
Indian company incorporated on 12 November 1987 in Kolkata, West Bengal, India and operating in
Machinery and Equipment (NIC 32201), registered with the RoC Kolkata under company
identification number U32201WB1987PTC043279.

The two companies have no connection: they share no ownership, no founders, no products,
and no business relationship.
